summary: LG Display Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K to notify an investor relations event — attending the Samsung Global Investors Conference on May 14, 2026 in Seoul for one-on-one and group meetings to discuss Q1 2026 financial results and Q&A. No transaction, material corporate event, or special situation is announced. This is a routine scheduling notice with no deal terms, board recommendation, or advisors. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. As a foreign private issuer notification of an investor conference, this is not a special situation under the defined categories.
